title: Cisco Catalyst Center Overview
description: Landing page for a Cisco Catalyst Center appliance: collection status, network and site health, client health and experience, and opt-in assurance issues and events.

definition.content:
Health of the network that one Cisco Catalyst Center appliance manages. **Collection success** is 1 when every enabled collector finished its last cycle and 0 when any of them failed. For per-device and per-interface detail, open the [Devices and Interfaces dashboard](/dash/integration/Cisco%20Catalyst%20Center%20Devices%20and%20Interfaces).

- [Integration docs](https://docs.datadoghq.com/integrations/cisco_catalyst_center/)
- [Integration tile](/integrations/cisco-catalyst-center)
- [Cisco Catalyst Center](https://www.cisco.com/site/us/en/products/networking/catalyst-center/index.html)

Network health is the share of monitored devices that Catalyst Center rates healthy: below 90% is worth a look, and below 80% is critical. When it drops, find the category holding the fair and poor devices, then open the Devices and Interfaces dashboard to see which devices they are.

Health, devices, clients, and open issues for every site, from Catalyst Center's site health summaries (on by default). Sites appear at each level of the hierarchy, from areas down to buildings and floors, so compare sites rather than adding them up. The site_hierarchy variable filters this section and client health by site, and accepts wildcards such as global/emea/*.
Catalyst Center's client health score and connected clients, where Overall covers wired and wireless together. Falling health with a steady client count points at connectivity or onboarding trouble.

Signal and onboarding per SSID and band, aggregated by Catalyst Center. Dashed lines mark the -67 dBm voice-grade and -80 dBm poor signal levels; a slow DHCP or authentication phase points at those servers, not RF.
Off by default: set `collect_assurance_issues: true` to fill this group, so empty graphs mean it is disabled, not broken. Priority runs from P1, the most severe, to P4.
Off by default: set `collect_events: true` to fill this group, so empty graphs mean it is disabled, not broken. Severity is the syslog scale, from 0 (most severe) to 6 (informational).

Datadog events for each assurance issue (`collect_assurance_issues`) and assurance event (`collect_events`), both off by default. Each one carries Catalyst Center's diagnosis, and issues include its suggested actions.
